name: George V of Georgia
contribution: The king of the Kingdom of Georgia from 1299 to 1302 and again from 1318 until his death in 1346.
legacy: He stopped paying tribute to the Mongols and expelled their army from the country.

checks.lead: George V the Brilliant (Georgian: გიორგი V ბრწყინვალე, romanized: giorgi V brts'q'invale; also translated as the Illustrious, or Magnificent; c. 1286–1346) of the Bagrationi dynasty, was the king (mepe) of the Kingdom of Georgia from 1299 to 1302 and again from 1318 until his death in 1346.
